name: r9-vectors-station-binding
note: A native manager's Station binding proof (delegated host-work III.5 (b) "Creating it"; Atem's answer on #120 comment 7207827118, owner decision 2026-11-27: a voluntary unbind needs the same proof as a bind or a transfer; Auth/Portal's agreement pending, Portal #41 comment 7208892757): wire {"body":<the Station's challenge>,"sig"} (R9.1's signed object, no kit_sig), signed over enc(["atem-station-binding-v1", jcs(body)]) by a current native member holding manage at the head (signer member:<device_id>) with its auth_key, Ed25519 (verify_strict) or P-256/SHA-256 64-byte r||s with low S, under the alg the device list pins. The body is the challenge, exactly: {type: atem-station-binding, v: 1, action, origin, issuer, subject, auth_time, account_id, genesis_hash, head{seq, hash}, signer, expected_binding, nonce, issued_at, expires_at}; action bind, transfer or unbind; origin exact as station_route::normalize_relay writes it; issuer and subject the token's exact iss and sub, 1-256 bytes of printable ASCII (0x21-0x7E), compared byte for byte; auth_time the token's auth_time in Unix seconds, 0 to 2^53-1, with auth_time * 1000 <= issued_at; account_id 1-128 bytes of [A-Za-z0-9._:-]; genesis_hash and head.hash lowercase hex; head.seq 1 to 2^53-1; signer member:<id> only (id 1-128 bytes of [A-Za-z0-9._:-]): a service:, host: or browser: signer is malformed, unlike the reports' unknown_signer (Atem's reading of that grammar); expected_binding exactly {state: never_bound} or {state: bound | unbound | released, binding_id (1-128 bytes of [A-Za-z0-9._:-]), version (1 to 2^53-1), owner (the exact sub the record names, the issuer's grammar)}; nonce 32 bytes base64url without padding; issued_at and expires_at ms with 0 < expires_at - issued_at <= 30000. Per action: bind names never_bound, unbound or released; transfer names bound and subject != owner (subject the intended new owner); unbind names bound and subject = owner. Strict I-JSON, exact fields at every level, no null, no array, no duplicate key (escaped ones included); a challenge text at most 4,096 bytes, the body's jcs at most 4,096 bytes, the proof at most 16 KiB. Atem's proposals, for Astation's agreement (asked on #120): owner is named in the unbound and released states too; the builder compares a transfer's subject, like every action's, with the subject the app supplies (the new owner it was shown); and both refusal orders below are those of Atem's answer (#120 comment 7207827118). Never fill expected from the challenge or anything the Station sent: take it from the app's own token, or, for a transfer, from what the user chose before the challenge was fetched (else binding_mismatch can never fire); before it prompts, the app compares the challenge's action (and, for a transfer, expected_binding.owner) with what the user started. `external`: Astation's three public examples (#120 comment 7205033056), verbatim, verify-only (no device list holds acct-example): each challenge reads, SHA-256(enc(["atem-station-binding-v1", jcs(challenge)])) is its signing_input_sha256, and its ed25519_sig and p256_sig verify under public_keys' ed25519 and p256 keys over that input (and over no other case's). Device lists: log L of r9-vectors-membership-log followed by `chain` (labels of `entries`, each with `on`, the labels it extends; signed by dev-mac but SB7_recovery_add_newmac, r9-vectors-membership-log's R7 byte for byte), then the carriage `freeze` (a label of r9-vectors-membership-log's others) when a case names one, which freezes it; each list verified at the case's now_ms. Keys are r9-vectors-keys' (`signed_with` names <name>/<part>: auth, or recovery/sign for the kit's recovery key); dev-desk is the Ed25519 manager SB7_add_desk adds; SB7_set_roles_phone demotes dev-phone to [control, view]. `challenges`: texts read by StationBindingChallenge::parse (bindings parse_station_binding_challenge): `fields` when read, else `code` malformed. `valid` and `invalid`: verify_station_binding(list, proof, the stored challenge `challenge`, now_ms): `expect` the VerifiedStationBinding {action, signer, head, at_head (true at the list's head, false at an ancestor), account_id, genesis_hash, issuer, subject, auth_time, expected_binding, nonce (base64url), expires_at}, with the proof's `jcs`, `signing_input_hex` and `signed_with`; or `code`, the first failure in the order malformed, frozen, wrong_account, unknown_signer, not_a_manager (no manage at the verifier's head), bad_signature, stale_log, fork, challenge_mismatch (the body isn't the stored challenge, compared on jcs), expired (bindings: Report{code}). The Station requires at_head. `builder`: station_binding_request(list, challenge, signer, station, expected{issuer, subject, auth_time}, now_ms): `body_json` (the held body, jcs(challenge)), or `code`, the first failure in the order malformed (signer not member:<id>, station not an origin, expected outside its grammar), frozen, wrong_account, origin_mismatch (the challenge minted for another Station than station normalized), signer_mismatch, unknown_signer, not_a_manager (no manage at the signer's own head), stale_log (the Station ahead of the signer: fetch first), fork, binding_mismatch (issuer, subject or auth_time other than expected), expired. `request`: the immutable request (bindings StationBindingRequest): built as a builder case, its sign_request (`purpose`, `fresh_confirmation`, `label`; input = enc([label, jcs(body)]), body_json = jcs(body)), then each `finishes` entry signs with `signed_with` the input of the held body (`over: held`) or of a request for the same challenge with another `nonce` (`over: {nonce}`), and finish gives the proof, byte-equal to {"body":<held body>,"sig":<the signature, low S>}, or `code`. What stays the Station's: the token's validation (aud = origin, iss, sub, exp, auth_time equal to the body's), the nonce store and single use, a transfer's consent, the disabled-account and binding_attempt rules, the commit-time recheck (head current, signer still manage, the record's state, binding_id and version equal to expected_binding) and exact retries.
